summary: Venu Holding Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a ticketing agreement with Ticketmaster L.L.C. on August 3, 2026. The agreement designates Ticketmaster as the exclusive ticketing agent for the company's amphitheaters under development in Broken Arrow, Oklahoma; McKinney, Texas; and El Paso, Texas. The initial term runs five years after the latest amphitheater opening, with automatic five-year renewals unless notice is given. Either party may terminate upon material breach or material financial events; Ticketmaster may terminate upon intellectual property infringement. The filing is a routine operational contract and does not constitute a special situation.
